findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: Inspector observes the bottom shelves of the reach in cooler, section 2, to have mold and soil accumulation. Clean the unit and maintain it free of accumulated soil. 
 
NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.comment:
3-202.15: FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

Observed multiple dented cans. Can voluntarily pulled from shelf. Discussed with PIC. Ensure staff is aware of not stocking dented cans. COS.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.citation_text:
6-202.15  (C) Exterior door allows access for pests. Exterior doors shall be: 1) self-closing, 2) solid and tight fitting, 3) limited to designed use. Reference 6-202.15.

Observed exterior door in back room to have gaps present on bottom part of door. Discussed repairs with PIC. Exterior doors must be solid and tight fitting to hinder access to pests.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.16  (C) Mop was found stored incorrectly in-between use. Mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies.  Reference 6-501.16

Observed two mops to be within the utility sink and not hanging in a manner that allows to air dry and/or drip dry. Mops should be stored properly in-between uses. Discussed appropriate mop hanging procedures with PIC. COS.
